components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in an operational action cluster.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(123, 111, 255, 0.4); border-radius: 7px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee), var(--deck-blue, #377df5) 48%, var(--deck-violet, #843dff)); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(26, 85, 169, 0.25); font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 780; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, filter 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: saturate(1.08) brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(39, 91, 184, 0.34); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee) 78%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.46; box-shadow: none; filter: saturate(0.55); cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A contained secondary action that stays subordinate to the gradient primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--deck-line-strong, rgba(181, 206, 227, 0.23)); border-radius: 7px; color: #d4deea; background: var(--deck-surface-inset, #07111c); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025); font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(40, 200, 238, 0.38); background: var(--deck-surface-high, #122136); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee) 78%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Inset Field
components.description: A dense operational field recessed into the work plane.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--deck-muted, #9baabd); font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--deck-line-strong, rgba(181, 206, 227, 0.23)); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--deck-text, #f3f6fa); background: var(--deck-surface-inset, #07111c); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(40, 200, 238, 0.32); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee) 70%, white); background: #091725; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24), 0 0 0 3px rgba(40, 200, 238, 0.1); outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee) 78%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Rail Item
components.description: The desktop rail's strong current-route treatment with an authored line icon.
components.html: Stewarding
components.css: .ds-rail-item { position: relative; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; color: #aeb9c8; background: transparent; font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.86rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-rail-item::before { position: absolute; inset: 9px auto 9px -14px; width: 2px; content: ""; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: transparent; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { color: #fff; border-color: var(--deck-line, rgba(181, 206, 227, 0.13)); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee) 78%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-item--active { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(81, 143, 239, 0.3); background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(29, 83, 157, 0.48), rgba(20, 54, 99, 0.72)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); } .ds-rail-item--active::before { background: var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee); }

components.name: Mobile Bottom Navigation
components.description: The safe-area-aware four-route mobile cockpit with a dedicated more action.
components.html: HomeRacingCareer
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { min-height: calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; padding: 6px max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(6px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); border-top: 1px solid var(--deck-line, rgba(181, 206, 227, 0.13)); background: var(--deck-rail-bg, #050d17); box-shadow: 0 -16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); } .ds-mobile-item { min-width: 0; min-height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 4px 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--deck-muted, #9baabd); background: transparent; font-family: "RaceVora UI", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mobile-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-mobile-item:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(45, 104, 184, 0.16); } .ds-mobile-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--deck-cyan, #28c8ee); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mobile-item:active { background: rgba(45, 104, 184, 0.34); } .ds-mobile-item--active { color: #fff; background: rgba(45, 104, 184, 0.24); }

narrative.overview:
RaceVora Control Deck is a calm, exacting motorsport operations environment: deep blue-black structure, disciplined information density, crisp authored linework, and just enough cyan-to-violet energy to mark state and consequence. It should feel like dependable race control software shaped by people who understand leagues, careers, stewarding, and live operations—not a themed entertainment dashboard.

Depth is physical but restrained. Matte navy planes separate navigation, work, controls, and active content through tone, edge light, and directed shadow. Runtime content, role boundaries, league identity, official marks, flags, and team art remain authoritative; the approved reference image establishes the visual world, not literal names, values, track art, actions, or a universal page composition.
keyCharacteristics: Four semantic depth layers with matte, non-glass surfaces
Persistent desktop rail and slim, visible league context bar
Safe-area-aware mobile bottom navigation and purposeful single-column reflow
Barlow Condensed hierarchy paired with Inter under the RaceVora UI name
Restrained cyan-to-violet emphasis reserved for active state and the primary action
Compact authored SVG line icons and text-supported status signals

rules.name: The Accent Economy Rule
rules.body: Reserve the cyan-to-violet spectrum for active state, focus, progress, and the single primary action cluster; its scarcity creates authority.

rules.name: The Status Requires Language Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger colors never carry meaning alone; pair them with a label, icon, mark, or explicit copy.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for real hierarchy; never add decorative pre-headlines, gradient text, slogan fragments, or ornamental all-caps above a clear title.

rules.name: The Four-Layer Rule
rules.body: Every surface must resolve to page ground, work plane, inset content, or raised active work; a new navy shade needs a semantic layer, not decorative novelty.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate containment and active hierarchy; they never become neon glow, glass haze, fake perspective, or inflated 3D.

dos: Do preserve runtime content, routes, role boundaries, league context, and existing official identity assets.
Do make the next meaningful action obvious while keeping the accent spectrum visually scarce.
Do assign every region to one of the four semantic depth layers and use directed shadows consistently.
Do keep operational layouts dense, aligned, and scan-friendly with tabular figures and stable labels.
Do pair every status color with explicit language or an authored SVG mark.
Do recompose for mobile with safe-area-aware bottom navigation, labeled records, and 44–48px targets.
donts: Don't produce AI-slop dashboard patterns, generic metric-card grids, or ornamental bento layouts.
Don't use glass, blur-backed translucency, neon glow, fake 3D, perspective tricks, or inflated controls.
Don't use gradient text or decorative pre-headlines.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as interface icons; use compact authored SVG line icons.
Don't promote the owner-control screenshot's proportions, invented data, or wide-plus-narrow arrangement into a global invariant.
Don't let cyan, violet, success, warning, or danger color become decoration without operational meaning.
